content.text: {"title":"Open Frequency","logline":"When a storm cuts off a small town, a rag-tag crew of community radio volunteers keeps a single emergency broadcast alive so residents can find shelter, medicine, and each other.","synopsis":"During a violent storm that has closed the bridge and killed the cell towers, the volunteers of Red Creek's community radio station scramble to restore their signal. Aria, Noah, June, and Kell haul a portable antenna to the water tower catwalk, where they pick up a desperate call for insulin and blankets from the north shelter. The broadcast becomes the town's lifeline, relaying road closures, shelter supplies, and personal messages through the long night.\n\nAt the high school gym shelter before dawn, June gathers updates while Kell organizes supplies and teenager Maya brings a flyer for her lost dog Comet. The station weaves the small, human request into its official bulletins, turning an emergency channel into a place where neighbors look out for one another. By morning the storm residue has cleared, the dog is found, and the four volunteers return to the studio under a steady ON AIR light, determined to keep the frequency open.","act_structure":[{"act_number":1,"title":"Setup","start_scene":"INT.
